sqlMap.select: SELECT TARGET ,KEY_1 ,KEY_2 ,KEY_3 ,KEY_4 ,KEY_5 ,KEY_6 ,KEY_7 ,KEY_8 FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TRK_JW' AND TARGET IN ('KRJW-P0001', 'KRC-C-0001', 'KRJW-B0001' , 'KRJW-L0001') AND KEY_9 = 'N' ORDER BY KEY_3
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = #FLAG# , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TRK_JW' AND TARGET = #TARGET# AND KEY_1 = #KEY_1# AND KEY_2 = #KEY_2# AND KEY_3 = #KEY_3# AND KEY_6 = #KEY_6# AND KEY_9 ='N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT KEP_SEQ AS SEQ ,BUYER AS BUYER ,BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION ,SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION ,STATUS AS STATUS ,UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE ,MAKER_NAME AS ITEM_MAKER ,CASE WHEN CATEGORY1 = '1' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ISCHEMICAL ,QUOTATION_NO ,QUOTATION_SEQ ,BELOW_COMORG_CODE ,DATA01 ,DATA02 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE BUYER ='KRJW-PG001' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #FLAG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #BUYER_ITEM_NO# AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND KEP_SEQ = #SEQ#
